name: Foreign Affairs
source:
Will you take your place on the world stage under your mother's presidential guidance? Or will you be the latest political hopeful to fall victim to scandal?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Foreign_Affairs]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
在身為總統的母親指導下，你會在世界舞臺上贏得一席之地，還是會成為又一個毀於醜聞的政壇新秀？
